graph.name: 2. Give this scene one clear direction
graph.description:
Use one editable instruction to give the next reply a clear direction.

What you'll learn:
• Text stores words you write yourself; it does not ask a model to write them.
• Guidance is advice sent to the reply model before it writes the reply. Compose turns the supplied text into that advice.

Before you start:
• Use a practice SillyTavern chat where you can try things freely. Open this example, then turn on Enable Lattice before sending a message. Your usual SillyTavern connection writes the reply.
• No extra model connection is needed. The Text and Compose boxes prepare the instruction themselves.

Steps:
1. Select Text · scene direction. In Details, replace the Text field with “Describe the dark lighthouse and one sound from the water. Leave my next action to me.” Move focus out of the field to save the edit.
2. Follow Text’s out wire into Compose’s section.Material port. Follow Compose’s out wire into Generate Reply’s guidance port. These wires place your instruction before reply writing.
3. Right-click Compose and choose Run to here for its output. Read Preview: the guidance should contain your lighthouse instruction. This preview prepares advice without writing or publishing a reply.
4. Send “I arrive at North Harbor.” After it finishes, compare the reply with your instruction. Look for the setting details and an opportunity to choose your own action.
5. Select Generate Reply and inspect its draft output, then follow that draft to Review / Publish as in lesson 1.
6. Finish at Review / Publish. Open its Host result in Preview, then choose Apply reviewed candidate to keep the proposed version or Reject candidate to discard it. Previewing an output does not make that choice for you.

Checkpoints:
Compose → out: Compose’s output contains the Text instruction, ready to guide Generate Reply before it writes.

Try this:
Replace the Text instruction with a quiet scene focused on wind and distant bells, then rerun Compose.
Preview shows the new advice immediately. The next Send uses it; preparing it needs no extra model request.

If something is different:
You change the instruction after a run.: The old result becomes Stale. Rerun to see advice from the new wording.
You preview Compose without sending.: You see the instruction, but no chat reply is written.

Model requests: 0 extra model requests; 1 normal SillyTavern reply when you Send.

direction.title: Text
direction.text: Give the scene one immediate, observable problem. Stop before choosing the player’s response.
